definitions.explanation: The first day of the weekend. The kanji 土 means 'earth/soil' and relates to Saturn (the 'earth planet' in East Asian tradition).

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: What do you do on Saturday?

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I take it easy on Saturday morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土曜日|どようび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ます→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: This Saturday I'm going to watch a movie with a friend.

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごします→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: The company is closed on Saturday and Sunday, so I spend time with my family.

notes:
{土曜日|どようび} means Saturday. The {土|ど} (earth/soil) relates to Saturn (the 'earth star' in East Asian astronomy).

FORMS:
- {土曜日|どようび}: Saturday (full form)
- ⟦{土曜|どよう}→土曜：22529_doyou⟧: Saturday (abbreviated)
- {土|ど}: Sat (very short, in schedules)

DAYS OF THE WEEK:
- ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧: Sunday ({日|にち} = sun)
- ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧: Monday ({月|げつ} = moon)
- ⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧: Tuesday ({火|か} = fire/Mars)
- ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧: Wednesday ({水|すい} = water/Mercury)
- ⟦{木曜日|もくようび}→木曜日：00653_mokuyoubi⟧: Thursday ({木|もく} = wood/Jupiter)
- ⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧: Friday ({金|きん} = metal/Venus)
- {土曜日|どようび}: Saturday ({土|ど} = earth/Saturn)

USAGE:
- "on Saturday" is {土曜日|どようび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, but the particle is routinely dropped in casual speech: {土曜日|どようび}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{土曜日|どようび}: every Saturday
- ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土曜日|どようび}: this coming Saturday
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土曜日|どようび}: next Saturday
- In schedules and calendars the day is written with the bare kanji: ({土|ど})

For most workers and students {土曜日|どようび} is part of the weekend, but many schools and some companies still hold classes or work on some Saturdays, so it is less uniformly a day off than Sunday.
Don't confuse with ⟦{土用|どよう}→土用：27533_doyou⟧ (18-day seasonal periods).
